instruction: Set VLC as the default application for playing video files

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC as default video player via system settings or right-click > Properties > Open With on a video file. Uses existing get_default_video_player getter and custom check_default_video_player__9b1915f5 metric to verify VLC is set as default via xdg-mime query.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if VLC is set as default video player, 0.0 otherwise
